{{Quote|I want to deploy  Delta and  Omega on  Coruscant to  identify and neutralize the Sep network here, because it is here. It has to be in order to strike us so easily. And CSF doesn't have the expertise or personnel to deal with this, and there might even be someone inside the CSF passing intel to the terrorists.|Kal Skirata to Arligan Zey|<ref name="tz">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
A '''strike team''' was formed in [[21 BBY]] by [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]] in order to [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|combat]] a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist terrorist network|terrorist cell]] that had been plaguing the GAR on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="tz" />

It was comprised of two [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] teams, [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta]] and [[Omega Squad]], [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null ARCs]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ordo Skirata|N-11 "Ordo"]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mereel Skirata|N-7 "Mereel"]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Bardan Jusik]] and [[Etain Tur-Mukan]], and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and ex-commando instructor [[Walon Vau]].<ref name="tz" />
